risks.risk: Engine displacement/engine code may not be 2.0 (or may be a different variant) leading to wrong fit and wrong parts.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/part number plate (usually on the engine block/head) and the VIN/engine code match label if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used Volkswagen engine assembly (worst-case: not confirmed 2.0 and not confirmed compatible), with no guarantee of correct fit.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: Passat vs Sharan may require different mounts, wiring harness, sensors, turbo/ECU, or intake/exhaust configuration.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact engine code plus close-ups of key interfaces: engine mounts, starter position, alternator bracket, and the connector types for major sensors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to be plug-and-play for either model (worst-case: buyer may need extra parts).

risks.risk: Condition risk: 'tested and working' and 'no knock' cannot be verified from a static photo; internal damage is possible.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start and short run (showing oil pressure/idle stability) or a mechanic test sheet with engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treat as for parts/repair until proven).

risks.risk: Missing components risk: the assembly shown may be incomplete (ECU, sensors, turbo, alternator, starter, wiring harness, intake manifold parts).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo laid out (or a checklist) showing every included part, plus a photo of the engine from multiple angles to confirm completeness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

A photo/inventory list of included items (ECU, alternator, starter, turbo if applicable, sensors, wiring harness, intake/exhaust manifolds).
Photos of key mounting points and connector interfaces to confirm Passat 2.0 and Sharan compatibility.
